rows.note: Use 報告 as the all-purpose choice for a formal or structured account of events or findings.

example.english: This report explains the results of this investigation.
example.traditional: 呢份報告講解今次調查嘅結果。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gong2 gaai2 gam1 ci3 diu6 caa4 ge3 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use 報道 when the report is a news account presented by the media.

example.english: The TV report says the bridge will be closed today.
example.traditional: 電視台嘅報道話，條橋今日要封。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 toi4 ge3 bou3 dou6 waa6 tiu4 kiu4 gam1 jat6 jiu3 fung1

rows.note: Use this for formally notifying an authority or giving official updates to a superior, rather than filing a police case or making a complaint.

example.english: I will report this progress to the manager.
example.traditional: 我會向經理報告呢項進度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 hoeng3 ging1 lei5 bou3 gou3 ni1 hong6 zeon3 dou6

rows.note: Use this when reporting someone as a formal complaint, especially to a boss, company, or organization.

example.english: I want to report that employee to the company.
example.traditional: 我要向公司投訴嗰個職員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 hoeng3 gung1 si1 tau4 sou3 go2 go3 zik1 jyun4

rows.note: For simply recounting an event, this is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.english: Let me report what happened to you first.
example.traditional: 等我講返件事畀你聽先。
example.jyutping: dang2 ngo5 gong2 faan1 gin6 si6 bei2 nei5 teng1 sin1

rows.note: Use this when reporting news or covering an event as a journalist.

example.english: We went to report on the concert today.
example.traditional: 我哋今日去報道個音樂會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 bou3 dou6 go3 jam1 ngok6 wui2
